description: List the earlier versions of a campaign's cadence template, newest first: when each was replaced and the start of each step. Every change to the template keeps the version it replaced (up to 30). For getting an earlier text back or seeing what changed. This is the edit history, not the numbered versions people follow ("Versão 2", "Versão 3"), which list_outreach_campaigns returns with campaignId.
name: list_cadence_versions
title: Histórico de edições da cadência
